title: Fab-site gas and chemical services: total gas and chemical management, on-site plants and delivery systems (Merck MEGASYS, Linde, Air Liquide, others)
why_it_matters: Gas companies build on-site plants under 10-20 year contracts and suppliers run fab chemical systems, a service and contract layer that SEMI's materials categories do not capture.
questions: Which firms operate gas and chemical delivery inside fabs and under what contract model?
How large is on-site gas supply for fabs versus merchant and packaged supply?
Does this layer create lock-in for materials suppliers?

title: Contamination-control and filtration suppliers (Entegris APS, Pall, Shin-Etsu Polymer, Gudeng): materials-adjacent segment outside SEMI's materials taxonomy
why_it_matters: Entegris' larger segment is filtration and wafer handling, not a SEMI materials category, so company revenue and SEMI market sizes do not reconcile; the segment's size and suppliers are unmapped.
questions: How big is the fab filtration/purification and wafer-carrier market and who supplies it?
Is it counted in SEMI equipment, materials or neither?
